part: 0201 (0603 metric, 0.6 x 0.3 mm) RC0201/NCP03 chip resistor / NTC
datasheet: Murata JEMCG0-2701K 'Soldering and Mounting / (2) Land Dimensions', Table 2 Reflow Soldering Method (a = gap between lands, b = land length, c = land width), printed in every GRM spec sheet, here GRM21BR71C106KE51L spec p32 (LCSC C408142, p23/merge/od/dl/murata/grm21_c408142.pdf)
derivation: 0201 (0603 metric, 0.6 x 0.3 mm) RC0201/RTT01/NCP03 chip resistor / NTC. IPC-7351C least density (D109): lands 0.26 x 0.30 at +-0.24 (pitch 0.48, gap 0.22, overall 0.74 x 0.30). Chip 0.60+-0.03 x 0.30+-0.03 (Murata GRM03 / LQP03 / BLM03, Yageo RC0201, Ralec RTT01): toe 0.07 past the nominal end, 0.055 at L max 0.63; land inner edge 0.11 (terminal inner edge >= 0.10 at the longest terminal e 0.20 / I2 0.20, heel -0.01); width 0.30 = W nominal (side 0; Murata GRM03 Table 2 c min 0.30 for the +-0.05 / +-0.09 chip rows, e.g. GRM033R71A103KA01-01A p25). Inside every Murata GR*03 Table 2 reflow range (a 0.20-0.30 -> 0.22, b 0.20-0.35 -> 0.26, c 0.20-0.40 -> 0.30). A 0.25 mm HDI microvia land (0.10 laser) fits inside each land (D107). Courtyard max(body, land) + 0.10 = 0.94 x 0.50 (land and body both 0.30 high).
